changelog:
Licensing Corrected, OpenWakeWord Migrated, Bluetooth Rebuilt

OpenWakeWord replaces VS catalog. Native C++ pipeline, shared audio analysis across multiple wake words, primed startup, no post-conversation warm-up. Echo-cancelled and noise-suppressed audio feeds detection directly. Voice Stats shows live score and threshold. Import compatible .onnx files, new catalog with author/source/license/checksum. Sensitivity now governs live detection, near-threshold rejections leave diagnostics. Thanks @ds2000 #187.

Bluetooth screen-off rebuilt: learns device addresses/manufacturers/services while screen on, dynamically injects filtered BLE scan targets when off. Sessions rotate, changed identities relearned, waits quietly when no valid target. Non-root devices reconnect without custom ROM or permanent Shizuku. Avoids aggressive adapter reset, low-end chips keep one working scanner, MediaTek/Unisoc recovery avoids Wi-Fi disturbance. Rooted devices keep HCI/MGMT path. Thanks @ds2000 #186.

LAN calling stability: call/hangup signals retransmitted, duplicates discarded, declined/ended sessions cannot ring again. Group call: one departure ends only own connection. Video receiver port rebinds correctly, black preview rebuilds after interruption. Incomplete frames expire, stale Wi-Fi addresses re-resolved. Camera orientation correct, Smooth/High/Ultra quality. Voice/video/control traffic stays LAN-local.

Peer metadata fill: pure Sendspin/mixed groups share missing song details without overwriting upstream. Sync-delay unlock guard protects calibrated rooms.

First-launch guide: 5-step actionable setup for permissions, start, HA add, pipeline select, completion. Existing installations skip automatically.

Simple Clock 12-hour AM/PM. Mod Store sends only genuine runtime permissions. Fleet: landscape tap fixed, stale device removal, thumbnail recovery. Voice messaging disabled devices hidden from call targets. Voice sphere stays until conversation ends. Dynamic Screensaver entity edits refresh service only, no cold start.
